summary: Li Auto Inc., the Chinese EV manufacturer listed in Hong Kong (02015) and on Nasdaq (LI), furnished a Form 6-K containing two Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 21 and 22, 2026, each filed under Main Board Rule 13.25A. The September 21 return discloses the repurchase of 1,272,800 WVR ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of HKD 45.7445 per share, held as treasury shares, reducing issued shares (excluding treasury) to 1,716,920,257, or 0.074% of the prior balance. No board recommendation or advisor was named. These are routine ongoing buyback disclosures, not a discrete special situation.
